items.summary: Invited users can now move real funds on the Polygon spin-off's privacy chain, though validators can still see private inputs for now.

items.title: Hyperliquid Formally Backs Kraken Parent's Push for US-Regulated Perps
items.summary: Hyperliquid named Payward its intended first CFTC-regulated HIP-3* deployer, though approval, a launch date, and HIP-3* mainnet are still pending.

items.title: Keystone Breach Widens as Attacker Grabs Its Device Authentication Key
items.summary: The hardware wallet maker will destroy 18,835 old devices and says it can't fully rule out fakes among units received after Oct. 20th.
